thesis: Even if human beings possessed the treasuries of Allah's mercy, the unpurified heart would still withhold out of fear of depletion — stinginess is a condition of the heart, not of resources.
notes: All four tafsir editions carry the thesis directly (Tabari incl. Ibn Abbas 'poverty' gloss; Muyassar; Jalalayn bakhilan). All 15 cross-referenced verses verified. All 8 root claims confirmed. Minor non-flag: Tabari glosses rahmah here as al-mal, file renders 'mercy and provision' — faithful in direction. Not ahkam-bearing.

thesis: Al-Hijr opens the Adam arc by placing both the human and the jann under the same divine verb of creation, so that material difference and temporal priority can never become proof of self-made superiority.
notes: Tabari's Qatadah report carries the fire-vs-clay superiority error; Ibn Kathir on Adam's noble origin. All roots confirmed (salsal, hama', masnun, jann, samum). Editorial note: tafsir identifies al-jann as Iblis specifically; file reads generically (as Ibn Kathir's English does) — permissible, no false attribution.
